description: One app of this site served on its own host name, e.g. crm.example.com for /crm. / on the host opens the app; a signed-out visitor signs in on the login host and is handed back with a single-use token. The session cookie stays host-only.

fields.description: Host name this app answers on, e.g. crm.example.com (no scheme, no port). Not a Public Site domain.
fields.label: Host

fields.description: Name shown for this app, optional.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: First URL segment of the app, e.g. crm for /crm.
fields.label: App Route

fields.description: Host that holds the sign-in and the desk, e.g. erp.example.com.
fields.label: Login Host

name: App Host
